description:
Deepseek V3.1 Cb language model served by SambaNova over an OpenAI-compatible API.

Requests are proxied through the UnitySVC gateway using your own SambaNova API key (the byok channel). The endpoint accepts both OpenAI Chat Completions and Anthropic Messages requests — the gateway auto-detects the dialect, translates to the upstream, and returns the response in the format you sent.
name: DeepSeek-V3.1-cb
